title: A Tutorial on Physics Constrained Machine Learning for Hybrid Modeling, Optimization, and Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.32914v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-constrained machine learning (PCML) integrates domain knowledge, first-principles, and physical constraints into AI/ML models. In this work, we present a step-by-step tutorial of a modular PCML framework, KKT-HardNet, and illustrate how it could be used for hybrid modeling, process simulation, optimization and model predictive control in a single platform. KKT-HardNet combines fast inference capabilities of neural networks with guaranteed satisfaction of algebraic constraints through differential projection. It can handle heterogeneous data and enforce both linear and nonlinear equality and inequality constraints. The modular design supports custom neural-network backbones and user-defined projection mechanisms for PCML. To enable efficient end-to-end training, KKT-HardNet exploits implicit function theorem to backpropagate through the projection layer. This avoids computationally expensive automatic differentiation. translated_title: 物理约束机器学习在混合建模、优化与控制中的教程
translated_abstract: 物理约束机器学习（PCML）将领域知识、第一性原理和物理约束集成到人工智能/机器学习模型中。在本工作中，我们提出了一个模块化PCML框架KKT-HardNet的分步教程，并说明如何在单一平台上将其用于混合建模、过程仿真、优化和模型预测控制。KKT-HardNet将神经网络的快速推理能力与通过微分投影保证满足代数约束相结合。它可以处理异构数据，并强制执行线性与非线性的等式和不等式约束。其模块化设计支持自定义神经网络主干以及用于PCML的用户自定义投影机制。为实现高效的端到端训练，KKT-HardNet利用隐函数定理来通过投影层进行反向传播，从而避免了计算代价高昂的自动微分。
tldr: 本文提出了模块化物理约束机器学习框架KKT-HardNet的分步教程，该框架通过微分投影保证约束满足，并利用隐函数定理实现高效端到端训练，可在单一平台上完成混合建模、过程仿真、优化与模型预测控制。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a step-by-step tutorial of a modular physics-constrained machine learning framework, KKT-HardNet, which guarantees constraint satisfaction via differential projection and achieves efficient end-to-end training using the implicit function theorem, enabling hybrid modeling, process simulation, optimization, and model predictive control on a single platform.
